data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella yacht charter in 2034 and need vegan catering? You're in luck. Whether you're cruising from Puerto Banús, Marbella Marina, or Cabopino, we offer fully customisable plant-based menus using fresh local produce. All our charters include vegan-friendly drinks and snacks, with the option to upgrade to a bespoke vegan feast. Prices start from €749/2h on our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), and every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and Spanish IVA. Let's dive into what's possible.

Vegan Catering Options on Every Charter

Our standard inclusions already cater to vegan guests: water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava are all vegan-friendly. Light snacks can be swapped for olives, nuts, vegetable crudités, hummus, or fresh fruit. For a full meal, just let us know your preferences when booking via WhatsApp. We'll arrange a menu featuring local ingredients like Marbella avocados, tomatoes, citrus, and almonds.

Which Boats Offer the Best Vegan Setup?

All boats in our fleet can accommodate vegan catering. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) and Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) have spacious galleys and fridges. For smaller parties, the Azimut 39 (11 pax) or Astondoa 40 (9 pax) are ideal. Tier A boats start at €749/2h, while Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 begin at €4,719/4h and include a free jet ski.

Local Vegan Produce from Marbella

Marbella's markets and suppliers offer abundant vegan-friendly ingredients. Think organic avocados from the Costa del Sol, sun-ripened tomatoes, juicy citrus, olives, almonds, and seasonal vegetables. We can craft Mediterranean-inspired dishes—like gazpacho, vegan paella, or tapas—using these local treasures. Just specify your preferences when booking.

How to Book Vegan Catering for 2034

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred boat, date, and dietary requirements. We'll confirm availability and customise your menu within 24 hours. For larger groups, consider the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94. For a more intimate experience, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are excellent choices. All charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella Marina, or Cabopino.

Additional Services for Vegan Guests

If you'd like a private chef or caterer to join your charter, we can arrange that for an additional fee. Alternatively, you're welcome to bring your own vegan food—our boats have fridges and storage. Just let us know in advance so we can prepare. For more inspiration, read our guide to Marbella yacht charter dietary restrictions.

Why Choose Our Marbella Yacht Charters?

We offer transparent pricing, licensed skippers, and inclusive packages that cover fuel, insurance, and IVA. No hidden costs. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply enjoying the Costa del Sol, our vegan catering options ensure everyone feels welcome. Explore our full fleet and book your 2034 charter today.
